rule: These diagnostics may downgrade or reject a primary-pass cell but may not authorize a new cell, timeframe, feature family, threshold or candidate.
excluded_from_candidate_consideration: F05 P3 H1 because the upper-timeframe state is largely pre-entry/static at the five-minute checkpoint
F05 P3 ALL because it is non-minimal and includes H1
B02 P3 because 2024H2 contains zero common-M1 P3 observations

feature_ablation: enrich price baseline with same-timeframe body, wick and close-location geometry
diagnostics.uncertainty: stratified bootstrap of fixed out-of-fold predictions; 2000 replicates; report 95% interval for AUC and AUC gain

economic_counterfactual.exit: next available M1 open after completed observation bar
economic_counterfactual.scope: fixed accepted trade ledger diagnostic only; not a binding portfolio replay

prohibited: feature selection from the robustness outcome
conversion of this diagnostic into an authorized candidate without a separate preregistration
